text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Yayoi Sho, a stepping stone to 
the Satsuki Sho. The crowd buzzed with 
excitement at the appearance of the 
much-anticipated Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki cheerfully calls out to a fan. 
Yet another person finds themselves 
falling under her spell.
